locations.name: BRM System Home ($PIN_HOME)
locations.description: Base installation directory for all Oracle BRM daemons, configurations, and tools.

locations.name: CM Configuration (pin.conf)
locations.description: Connection Manager daemon config: port bindings, max connections, dm_pointer, fm_module shared libraries.

locations.name: DM Oracle Configuration (pin.conf)
locations.description: Data Manager config: database TNS alias, database credentials (sm_pw), max DB connections, transaction limits.

locations.name: Infranet Properties (infranet.properties)
locations.description: Java SDK & EAI Framework properties: JNDI bindings, CM connection pool, logging levels.

locations.name: Billing Engine Config (pin_billd/pin.conf)
locations.description: Automated billing daemon: billing dates, batch sizes, multi-threading partitions.

locations.name: CM Pinlog (cm.pinlog)
locations.description: Connection Manager activity log: opcode dispatches, client connection events, flist errors.

locations.name: DM Oracle Pinlog (dm_oracle.pinlog)
locations.description: Data Manager activity log: Oracle SQL statements, database constraint violations, ORA- errors.

locations.name: Event Notification Config (pin_notify)
locations.description: Maps system and business events to automatic opcode trigger subscriptions.

locations.name: BRM Header Files (*.h)
locations.description: C/C++ headers defining PIN_FLD_*, PCM_OP_*, PIN_ERR_*, and storable classes.
